title: Define the Minimum Viable Business Product
not_for: A disconnected prototype or a long-term feature roadmap.
input_gate: Scope one complete, safe value-delivery and payment path. Proposed usage or payment is not observed traction.

scope.boundary: One approved export format; no automatic sending

launch_gates.metric: Accurate drafts reviewed by the owner
launch_gates.threshold: Every draft reconciles to approved hours
launch_gates.stop_condition: Stop if incorrect invoices could be sent

example_note: Manual work is acceptable when capacity, responsibility, and cost are explicit. A payment path is not proof that payment occurred.
failure_case: No accountable delivery owner, no payment path, or absent stop conditions makes the scope incomplete.
